you-win-subtitle: Your machine has successfully created the desired products.
message-please-rename-solution: Please enter a new name for this solution:

refined-gold.before-0: Well, this is an odd first project. I feel like someone's having a laugh at my expense.
refined-gold.before-1: Why, were you asked to create the Philosopher’s Stone?
refined-gold.before-4: Yes. Apparently there’s an old Van Tassen lead mine, and wouldn’t it be better if it produced gold instead of lead?
refined-gold.before-6: Sounds wonderful. Time to put your University degree to the test!
refined-gold.after-2: Well, at least it’s finished with now.
refined-gold.after-3: Like asking a fish if it can swim!
refined-gold.after-4: You're taking this remarkably poorly, Anataeus.
refined-gold.after-5: I was expecting a challenge, that’s all.
refined-gold.after-6: Sounds like you want a chance to show off.
refined-gold.after-7: I’m not sure I’d go that far.

face-powder.before-0: Have you seen the Lady Van Tassen recently?
face-powder.before-2: Did you notice how pale her face is?
face-powder.before-3: Oh, she's well known for her pallor. Why, did someone ask you to do something about it?
face-powder.before-4: Armand himself did. It seems it’s gotten worse lately. People are whispering about her health.
face-powder.before-6: The Lady hasn’t had an easy time of things. I’d hate to see her slandered on top of it all.
face-powder.after-0: This should make the Lady’s face look less pale. Though it’s quite a superficial solution.
face-powder.after-1: Who can really say what troubles the Lady Van Tassen? It’s not for us to know.
face-powder.after-2: Have you ever heard her speak? She didn’t say a word during the dinner I went to.
face-powder.after-3: I remember her speaking to me once or twice when I was a child.
face-powder.after-4: Odd. Just another one of the many Van Tassen mysteries, I suppose.
face-powder.after-5: One gets used to them after a while.

waterproof-sealant.before-0: Do you know much about ships, Concordia?
waterproof-sealant.before-1: Our merchant fleet delivers goods from overseas about once a month. Why?
waterproof-sealant.before-2: Captain Gelt told me they used to have some kind of substance they put on the hulls so they don’t rot.
waterproof-sealant.before-3: I don’t know anything about it. Have you ever been on a ship?
waterproof-sealant.before-5: Not at all. It soudns ghastly! Being tossed around on the ocean, then getting eaten by sea monsters.
waterproof-sealant.before-6: I’m not sure all sea voyages are like that.
waterproof-sealant.after-0: With this sealant ready, the fleet should soon be ready to set sail again and bring back— well, whatever it brings.
waterproof-sealant.after-1: They’re loaded with all kinds of things. Cloth, pottery, mineral ores, rare herbs... strange stones.
waterproof-sealant.after-4: I’m not sure. Those contracts were drawn up centuries ago.
waterproof-sealant.after-5: I doubt even Armand knows the details.

hangover-cure.before-0: If I’d known I was to be tasked with curing a hangover…
hangover-cure.before-1: Oh, I bet I know who asked you for that. It was Captain Gelt, wasn’t it?
hangover-cure.before-3: It would be good for him to be at least somewhat functional in the mornings.
hangover-cure.before-4: Yes, seems prudent for the head of security for the entire House to not be totally incapacitated on a regular basis.
hangover-cure.after-0: There are days when I could use such a cure myself.
hangover-cure.after-2: What? This isn’t for me, Anataeus. If you get caught–
hangover-cure.after-4: My amazing hangover cure… is water!
hangover-cure.after-6: Captain Gelt has no idea, but apparently he loves it. Works wonders, he says.
hangover-cure.after-8: Also, I’ll never trust an alchemist again.

airship-fuel.before-0: Captain Gelt asked for something to put in the Van Tassen airship. Apparently it’s out of fuel?
airship-fuel.before-2: First time I’ve heard someone say “that old thing” in reference to an airship…
airship-fuel.before-3: The last time I remember the airship in the air was the celebration for Frederick’s birth.
airship-fuel.before-4: Clearly Frederick disappointed his grandfather so much they never took it out again.
airship-fuel.before-5: Ha. More likely it’s simply been out of fuel this whole time.
airship-fuel.before-6: The whole time? Are you serious?
airship-fuel.before-7: After the old Head Alchemist died we had an “interim” one for a while who was… not great.
airship-fuel.after-0: Simple enough. Now the Van Tassen airship can take to the skies again!
airship-fuel.after-1: Sure, as long as we can find someone to pilot it.
airship-fuel.after-2: Doesn’t seem too complicated. How about me?
airship-fuel.after-3: How about Captain Gelt? Or Frederick?
airship-fuel.after-4: That’s a disturbing thought… maybe we should pretend the airship is still out of fuel.

precision-machine-oil.before-2: Apparently Armand arranged for Frederick to go on a date with a young lady from another House.
precision-machine-oil.before-4: And now I have to make some machine oil.
precision-machine-oil.before-6: For the observatory. Frederick tried to take her there, but everything was rusted solid.
precision-machine-oil.before-8: Even better? Clara, the young lady, is from House Soria.
precision-machine-oil.before-9: He was probably hoping to prove our observatory is just as good as theirs.
precision-machine-oil.before-10: Oh, she must’ve been tremendously impressed all around.
precision-machine-oil.after-0: Well, Frederick’s dates at the observatory ought to go better now. Maybe he and Clara could have a do-over.
precision-machine-oil.after-1: I don’t think it works like that.
precision-machine-oil.after-2: Do you see any other choices?
precision-machine-oil.after-3: For Clara Soria? I believe House Colvan has a young man around Frederick’s age.
precision-machine-oil.after-4: Maybe that’s what Armand is trying to prevent, no?
precision-machine-oil.after-5: Quite likely. Pity he has only Frederick to work with.
precision-machine-oil.after-6: One can only play the game with the pieces one has.

health-tonic.before-0: Do you know exactly how old Armand is?
health-tonic.before-1: Both he and the Lady are rather advanced in age.
health-tonic.before-2: And Frederick is the only possible heir?
health-tonic.before-3: As Armand’s only surviving grandson, he would be difficult to oppose.
health-tonic.before-4: There are some other claimants from distant branches of the family, but they’re weak.
health-tonic.before-6: Promise not to tell anyone, but I was asked to make a tonic to assist in regulating an irregular heartbeat.
health-tonic.before-7: Oh Armand… hopefully he’s set up everything for an orderly succession of power after he’s gone.
health-tonic.before-8: Let’s not get too ahead of ourselves. I do intend to keep him healthy.
health-tonic.after-0: There, that should do it. One healthy-ish patriarch for the House Van Tassen, as ordered.
health-tonic.after-4: I do think it’s good if he stays alive.
health-tonic.after-5: After all, he pays for everything around here.
health-tonic.after-6: You’d do well to show a little more appreciation for your House.

stamina-potion.before-0: “A little boost at the necessary time.”
stamina-potion.before-2: “A little boost at the necessary time,” is how he put it…
stamina-potion.before-6: Particularly: He wonders if Frederick will be able to produce an heir.
stamina-potion.before-8: I’m to make him a potion that will…
stamina-potion.before-9: …give him a boost at the necessary time, I get it.
stamina-potion.before-10: That’s not so unusual, really. Stamina potions have long been used for such purposes.
stamina-potion.before-11: It’s not making it that’s the issue for me. It’s thinking about it.
stamina-potion.before-12: You should know better than to use your imagination in cases like this.
stamina-potion.after-0: I hope Frederick enjoys that potion… ugh.
stamina-potion.after-1: Armand must believe Frederick’s marriage is close at hand.
stamina-potion.after-2: Really? Really? Will it be the young lady from House Soria?
stamina-potion.after-4: How exciting! The city would celebrate for days. The union of House Van Tassen and House Soria…
stamina-potion.after-5: As Provisioner, you’d have a lot of work to do.
stamina-potion.after-6: Yes, but it would be for a wedding! It would be quite fun.
stamina-potion.after-7: You arrange the party in the streets, I arrange the party in the sheets.

chapter-1-intro.name: Van Tassen’s New Alchemist
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-2: Armand kept going through his old stories about honor and righteousness.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-3: The Lady Van Tassen looks like she’s embalmed.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-4: Frederick spilled food down the front of his shirt.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-5: What a brave man you are, surviving a formal dinner!
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-6: It really is difficult, though. I can’t stand the stuffiness.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-7: Armand didn’t remember my name. Captain Gelt had to prompt him several times.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-8: To be fair, you started only rather recently.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-9: Yes, I suppose it’s too much to ask. Such a complicated, burdensome thing, to remember one single name, the name of your new Alchemist.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-10: The one who graduated at the top of his class from the College of Alchemical Engineering…
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-12: See! You remember my name just fine.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-13: Think Armand would know my name? Keeping in mind I’ve been here my whole life.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-14: Maybe next time you can go in my place! He might not even realize it’s a different person.
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-15: “Hnnngh, Alchemist… Provisioner… which were you again? Mm, yes, hnnnngh…”
chapter-1-intro.dialogue-17: I’ve been doing this for years.

chapter-1-outro.name: An Act of Aggression
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-0: That’s when I decided we needed to re-inventory everything in the building. You should have seen the look on Armand’s face!
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-7: I am not moping. I am merely… moodily dehjected.
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-8: And what has the great alchemist of House Van Tassen so moodily dejected?
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-9: Nothing. I mean, I’m thinking about why I’m here.
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-10: You’re here because you’re our Alchemist.
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-11: I mean in the larger sense…
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-12: The alchemist is here, isn’t he?
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-13: Captain Gelt, what can I do for you?
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-14: Your presence is required in the main hall. It’s a matter of some emergency.
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-16: An aggressive move from another House has taken us by surprise… we need to respond immediately.
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-17: My alchemy is at your disposal.
chapter-1-outro.dialogue-19: I am! Finally, something significant is happening!
